mn24:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
mn24:2.1: atha kho sambahulā jātibhūmikā bhikkhū jātibhūmiyaṃ vassaṃ vuṭṭhā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etadavoca
mn24:2.2: ko nu kho bhikkhave jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito
mn24:2.3: attanā ca appiccho appicchakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca santuṭṭho santuṭṭhikathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca pavivitto vivekakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca asaṃsaṭṭho asaṃsaggakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca āraddhaviriyo viriyārambhakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca sīlasampanno sīlasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca samādhisampanno samādhisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca paññāsampanno paññāsampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca vimuttisampanno vimuttisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ovādako viññāpako sandassako samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnanti.
mn24:2.4: puṇṇo nāma bhante āyasmā mantāṇiputto jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito
mn24:2.5: attanā ca appiccho appicchakathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā attanā ca santuṭṭho …pe… attanā ca pavivitto … attanā ca asaṃsaṭṭho … attanā ca āraddhaviriyo … attanā ca sīlasampanno … attanā ca samādhisampanno … attanā ca paññāsampanno … attanā ca vimuttisampanno … attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ovādako viññāpako sandassako samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnanti.
mn24:3.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.
mn24:3.3: lābhā āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa suladdhaṃ āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa
mn24:3.4: yassa viññū sabrahmacārī satthu sammukhā anumāssa anumāssa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti tañca satthā abbhanumodati
mn24:3.5: appevanāma mayampi kadāci karahaci āyasmatā puṇṇena mantāṇiputtena saddhiṃ samāgamaṃ gaccheyyāma appevanāma siyā kocideva kathāsallāpoti.
mn24:4.1: atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
mn24:4.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn24:4.4: assosi kho āyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto bhagavā kira sāvatthiṃ anuppatto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmeti.
mn24:5.1: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena sāvatthī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
mn24:5.2: anupubbena cārikañcaramāno yena sāvatthī jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn24:5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
mn24:5.4: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena andhavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn24:6.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
mn24:6.2: yassa kho tvaṃ āvuso sārīputta puṇṇassa nāma bhikkhuno mantāṇiputtassa abhiṇhaṃ kittayamāno ahosi so bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena andhavanaṃ tena pakkanto divāvihārāyāti.
mn24:7.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto taramānarūpo nisīdanaṃ ādāya āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputataṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi sīsānulokī.
mn24:7.2: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi
mn24:7.3: āyasmāpi kho sāriputto andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
mn24:8.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā puṇṇena mantāṇiputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
mn24:8.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ etadavoca
mn24:9.3: kinnu kho āvuso sīlavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavataṃ brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:9.5: kiṃ panāvuso cittavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:9.7: kinnu kho āvuso diṭṭhivisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:9.9: kiṃ panāvuso kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:9.11: kinnu kho āvuso maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:9.13: kiṃ panāvuso paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:9.15: kinnu kho āvuso ñāṇadassanavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:10.1: kinnu kho āvuso sīlavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
mn24:10.2: kiṃ panāvuso cittavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
mn24:10.3: kinnu kho āvuso diṭṭhivisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi kiṃ panāvuso
mn24:10.7: kho āvuso ñāṇadassanavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
mn24:10.9: anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ kho āvuso bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:11.15: kiṃ panāvuso aññatra imehi dhammehi anupādāparinibbānanti.
mn24:12.1: kinnu kho āvuso sīlavisuddhi anupādāparinibbānanti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
mn24:12.2: kiṃ panāvuso cittavisuddhi anupādāparinibbānanti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
mn24:12.3: kinnu kho āvuso diṭṭhivisuddhi anupādāparinibbānanti …pe… kiṃ panāvuso
mn24:12.7: kinnu kho āvuso ñāṇadassanavisuddhi anupādāparinibbānanti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
mn24:12.8: kiṃ panāvuso aññatra imehi dhammehi anupādāparinibbānanti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
mn24:12.9: yathākathaṃ panāvuso imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabboti.
mn24:13.1: sīlavisuddhiṃ ce āvuso bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa saupādānaññeva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa. cittavisuddhiṃ
mn24:13.2: ce āvuso bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa saupādānaññeva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa. diṭṭhivisuddhiṃ
mn24:13.3: ce āvuso bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa saupādānaññeva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa. kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhiṃ
mn24:13.4: ce āvuso bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa saupādānaññeva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa. maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhiṃ
mn24:13.5: ce āvuso bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa saupādānaññeva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa. paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhiṃ
mn24:13.6: ce āvuso bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa saupādānaññeva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa. ñāṇadassanavisuddhiṃ
mn24:13.7: ce āvuso bhagavā anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa saupādānaññeva samānaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ paññāpessa.
mn24:13.8: aññatra ce āvuso imehi dhammehi anupādāparinibbānaṃ abhavissa puthujjano parinibbāyeyya
mn24:13.9: puthujjano hi āvuso aññatra imehi dhammehi.
mn24:14.2: upamāyapidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
mn24:14.3: seyyathāpi āvuso rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasantassa sākete kiñcideva accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ uppajjeyya
mn24:14.4: tassa antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ satta rathavinītāni upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ
mn24:14.5: atha kho āvuso rājā pasenadi kosalo sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvāre paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhirūheyya paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhirūheyya
mn24:14.6: dutiyena rathavinītena tatiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya tatiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhirūheyya
mn24:14.7: tatiyena rathavinītena catutthaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya tatiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya catutthaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhirūheyya
mn24:14.8: catutthena rathavinītena pañcamaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya catutthaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya pañcamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhirūheyya
mn24:14.9: pañcamena rathavinītena chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya pañcamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhirūheyya
mn24:14.10: chaṭṭhena rathavinītena sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhirūheyya
mn24:14.12: tamenaṃ antepuradvāragataṃ samānaṃ mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
mn24:14.13: iminā tvaṃ mahārāja rathavinītena sāvatthiyaṃ sāketaṃ anuppatto antepuradvāranti
mn24:14.14: kathaṃ byākaramāno nu kho āvuso mahārājā pasenadi kosalo sammā byākaramāno byākareyyāti.
mn24:14.15: evaṃ byākaramāno kho āvuso rājā pasenadi kosalo sammā byākaramāno byākareyya
mn24:14.16: idha me sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasantassa sākete kiñcideva accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ uppajji
mn24:14.17: tassa me antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ satta rathavinītāni upaṭṭhapesuṃ
mn24:14.18: atha khvāhaṃ sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvāre paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruyhiṃ
mn24:14.19: paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇiṃ paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ nissajjiṃ dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruyhiṃ
mn24:14.20: dutiyena rathavinītena tatiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇiṃ dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ nissajjiṃ tatiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruyhiṃ
mn24:14.21: tatiyena rathavinītena catutthaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇiṃ tatiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ nissajjiṃ catutthaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruyhiṃ
mn24:14.22: catutthena rathavinītena pañcamaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇiṃ catutthaṃ rathavinītaṃ nissajjiṃ pañcamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruyhiṃ
mn24:14.23: pañcamena rathavinītena chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇiṃ pañcamaṃ rathavinītaṃ nissajjiṃ chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruyhiṃ
mn24:14.24: chaṭṭhena rathavinītena sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇiṃ chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ nissajjiṃ sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruyhiṃ
mn24:14.26: evaṃ byākaramāno kho āvuso rājā pasenadi kosalo sammā byākaramāno byākareyyāti
mn24:15.1: evameva kho āvuso sīlavisuddhi yāvadeva cittavisuddhatthā cittavisuddhi yāvadeva diṭṭhivisuddhatthā diṭṭhivisuddhi yāvadeva kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhatthā kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi yāvadeva maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhatthā maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhi yāvadeva paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhatthā paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi yāvadeva ñāṇadassanavisuddhatthā ñāṇadassanavisuddhi yāvadeva anupādāparinibbānatthā
mn24:15.2: anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ kho āvuso bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
mn24:16.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ etadavoca
mn24:16.2: ko nāmo āyasmā kathañca panāyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantīti.
mn24:16.4: mantāṇiputtoti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantīti.
mn24:16.6: yathātaṃ sutavatā sāvakena sammadeva satthu sāsanaṃ ājānantena evamevaṃ āyasmatā puṇṇena mantāṇiputtena gambhīrā gambhīrā paññā anumāssa anumāssa byākatā
mn24:16.8: ye āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ labhanti dassanāya labhanti payirupāsanāya
mn24:16.9: velaṇḍukena cepi sabrahmacārī āyasmantaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ muddhanā pariharantā labheyyuṃ dassanāya labheyyuṃ payirupāsanāya tesampi lābhā tesampi suladdhaṃ amhākampi lābhā amhākampi suladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ labhāma dassanāya labhāma payirupāsanāyāti.
mn24:17.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
mn24:17.2: ko nāmo āyasmā kathañca panāyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantīti.
mn24:17.4: sāriputtoti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantīti.
mn24:17.5: satthukappena vata kira bho sāvakena saddhiṃ mantayamānā na jānimha
mn24:17.7: sace hi mayaṃ jāneyyāma āyasmā sāriputtoti ettakampi no nappaṭibhāseyya
mn24:17.9: yathātaṃ sutavatā sāvakena sammadeva satthu sāsanaṃ ājānantena evamevaṃ āyasmatā sāriputtena gambhīrā gambhīrā paññā anumāssa anumāssa pucchitā
mn24:17.11: ye āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ labhanti dassanāya labhanti payirupāsanāya
mn24:17.12: velaṇḍukena cepi sabrahmacārī āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ muddhanā pariharantā labheyyuṃ dassanāya labheyyuṃ payirupāsanāya tesampi lābhā tesampi suladdhaṃ amhākampi lābhā amhākampi suladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ labhāma dassanāya labhāma payirupāsanāyāti.
mn24:17.13: itiha te ubhopi mahānāgā aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ samanumodiṃsūti.
